name: Hindustan Unilever Ltd
title: Hindustan Unilever Ltd - 500696 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: HUL's Q4 FY26 USG of 7% and FY27 "better than FY26" outlook rest on volume-led demand; price hikes of 2-5% against 8-10% material inflation leave margin relying on a 22.5-23.5% band.

utilisation.quote: We are happy to report that we were able to manage our production and supplies without any disruption.

capex.quote: we have also signed off a Rs. 2,000 crores planned capex investment to expand capacity in the premium formats

triggers.label: Material cost inflation 8-10%
triggers.quote: we have seen a cost inflation of around 8% to 10% so far on our material cost base

triggers.label: Price increases 2-5% taken
triggers.quote: we have already taken a price increase to the extent of 2% to 5% depending on portfolio to portfolio

triggers.label: Exit-March USG 7% vs 2% FY25
triggers.quote: We exited March quarter '26 with 7% USG, accelerating from the 2% USG in FY'25

triggers.label: No restocking or pre-buying in Q4
triggers.quote: we did not witness any pre- buying from traders in the quarter

triggers.label: FY27 expected better than FY26
triggers.quote: we expect FY '27 to be better than FY '26

guidance.quote: we expect the mid-term margin guidance to remain around our current guided range of 22.5% to 23.5%
we expect FY '27 to be better than FY '26

red_flags.label: Margin band leans on pricing lag vs 8-10% input inflation
red_flags.quote: we have already taken a price increase to the extent of 2% to 5% depending on portfolio to portfolio

red_flags.label: Personal Care volume decline
red_flags.quote: this vertical has continued to see volume decline

evasions.quote: it's very difficult to give out a number or b number for the full year
we don't split our business in this fashion
We don't break down the growth of all our sub-categories.
